critical_code_review_comments: BehaviorWeatherFetcher correctly uses Open-Meteo API (free, no API key required)
Lunar phase calculation uses astronomical algorithm based on reference new moon (2024-01-11)
Synodic month constant (29.53058770576 days) used for accurate lunar calculations
Real-time data includes: temperature, humidity, precipitation, cloud cover, pressure, wind
Photoperiod (sunrise/sunset) fetched from Open-Meteo with golden hour calculations
Pressure trend analysis (rising/falling/stable) integrated for hunting impact
All engines properly return data_source='real_time' when fetching live data
Fallback to estimated data when API calls fail (graceful degradation)
